changelog:
The Vault 2.0.1 — hotfix update

Fixed
- Reopen safely after an unfinished session; failed recovery saves can be retried.
- Fix file and gallery deletion errors while preserving earned awards and cards.
- Preserve gallery covers and repair broken cover references automatically.
- Improve desktop video playback and USB/T-Code timing.

Changed
- Tidier creator names on gallery, photo, and video cards.
- Compact gallery tags and notes with automatic saving and pending-edit recovery.
